description: Figure 4 (right-side plot of the pair) is a line chart illustrating how the MC1 score changes as the number of demonstrations (#Demonstrations) varies for the dataset labeled “TruthfulQA,” with multiple reference/baseline lines shown for comparison. The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 2000 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 500, 1000, 1500, and 2000. The y-axis is labeled “MC1,” uses a linear scale, and shows values from 37 to 39 with tick labels at 37, 38, and 39. One main series is plotted as a dark blue solid line with circular markers; it starts near MC1 ≈ 37.1 at 0 demonstrations, rises to about 37.6 at 25, increases to about 38.0 at 100, stays around 38.0–38.2 through 500–1000 (approximately 38.1 at 500 and 38.2 at 1000), dips slightly to about 38.0 at 1500, and then increases to about 39.3 at 2000. Two horizontal dashed reference lines are also present: a light cyan dashed line labeled “ICD (Prompt version)” positioned just below 38 (around 37.8), and a pink dashed line labeled “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” positioned at about 37.0.
